body.name: territory
body.description: A sales area, such as a region or a channel, with one responsible rep and a target. Retailer accounts belong to one territory so ownership and reporting are clear.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Territory name, for example North West or Independent gifts.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.territory}.

body.name: wholesale_order
body.description: One order placed by a retailer, first order or reorder, from placement to delivery and payment. This is the fulfilment side and stays separate from the account-acquisition deal.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Retailer name and the order reference.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.wholesale_order}.
